summary: Iteration 2 validated the 4 new features (edit entry, handover history, vitals trend, redesigned home) plus regression of all iteration-1 delete/restore/wipe flows. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass (11 regression + 11 new for PATCH /entries, /handovers list+delete, /patients/{id}/trend including BP dual-value parsing, temperature single-value, case-insensitive label, 404 handling, non-numeric skipping). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: greeting text (Buon pomeriggio), quick-stats card shown only when patients>0, search filters by name and by pathology, 'Nessun risultato' state, patient card avatar initials, patient detail page loads, trend card visible with 4 BP readings showing 2 recharts lines (max+min), switching to Temperatura shows 1 line, entry ⋮ menu shows 'Modifica voce' and 'Elimina voce', edit dialog opens, saves via PATCH, persistence verified via GET, patient delete menu still works (regression).

issues: Recharts console warning 'width(-1) height(-1)' briefly emitted on first render before ResponsiveContainer measures. Cosmetic only; chart renders correctly. Consider setting explicit minHeight on the wrapper div to silence the warning.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py PATCH /entries/{id}: `updates` filters out None but also silently drops empty-string values sent from the frontend (e.g. user clearing a unit). Since EntryUpdate uses exclude_unset AND the code re-filters `v is not None`, empty string '' still gets through — good. However mixing exclude_unset with `if v is not None` means a client explicitly sending null (to clear a field) is ignored. If clearing fields is desired, drop the `is not None` filter.
server.py POST /ai/handover: on LLM error it still stores nothing (good), but on success it stores handover BEFORE returning; no rollback if insert fails. Minor.

server.py trend endpoint: labels are derived only from vitals in the last `days` window, but the label filter for the series is case-insensitive while the labels list preserves original case — front-end passes labels[0] verbatim so this works. OK.
App.js is now ~1418 lines — still a single file. Splitting PatientDetail, EditEntryDialog, and PatientsList into separate modules is overdue for maintainability.

App.js EditEntryDialog: onSave fires with `kind` from the select but backend accepts arbitrary strings — no client-side guard forces one of the 4 valid enum values (Select already restricts to those 4, but there is no defensive validation).

App.js trend chart tooltip formatter uses `trendData[0]?.unit` for BOTH lines — for BP that shows 'mmHg' on both max and min which is correct, but for other multi-value labels the label 'min' would still apply. Acceptable given current schema.

App.js handover history card: cards inserted from history don't set `handoverLoading` back to false explicitly — dialog opens with text preset which is fine, but if user then clicks 'Genera' the same dialog is reused. Consider distinguishing 'viewing historical' vs 'newly generated' modes.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — flagged in iter 1, unchanged.
seed_data_creation: All tests self-clean via /api/data/wipe (autouse fixture in backend, explicit call in frontend Playwright). No persistent seed remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_caregiver_api.py runs 22 pytest tests in ~6s and auto-wipes the DB before each test. All new endpoints covered: PATCH /entries (update/empty/404), /handovers (list empty, delete 404), /patients/{id}/trend (labels, BP dual-value, single-value, case-insensitive, patient 404, non-numeric skip). Frontend data-testids added in iter 2: patients-title, patients-search, quick-stats, trend-card, trend-select, handover-history-card, handover-history-{id}, edit-entry-dialog, edit-entry-kind, edit-entry-label, edit-entry-value, edit-entry-unit, edit-entry-save, entry-{id}-menu-btn, entry-{id}-edit, entry-{id}-delete. Trend endpoint returns {labels: [...]} without ?label and {label, unit, series[{t,value,value2?,raw,unit}]} with ?label. Real LLM handover was NOT triggered in test to avoid flakiness/cost; POST /ai/handover storage-in-history was validated indirectly via list/delete tests.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Minor cosmetic recharts warning on first paint due to ResponsiveContainer measuring before layout — non-blocking.
